sans.$description: Primary sans font stack optimized for Vietnamese UI and stacked diacritics

mono.$description: Tabular and code font stack with Vietnamese currency symbol support

serif.$description: Editorial serif font stack with verified uppercase diacritic positioning

display2xl.$description: Mandatory floor >= 1.18 for 60px-72px display headings to prevent diacritic clipping

headingSm.$description: Mandatory floor >= 1.28 for 18px-20px subheadings and modal headers

bodyLg.$description: Mandatory floor >= 1.50 for 16px-18px body prose to prevent diacritic crowding

bodyMd.$description: Mandatory floor >= 1.50 for 14px-15px standard interface text

bodySm.$description: Mandatory floor >= 1.45 for 12px-13px helper text and metadata

caption.$description: Mandatory floor >= 1.35 for 10px-11px micro-labels and badges

tight.$description: Max negative tracking allowed on display headings (never exceed -0.01em for vi-VN)

normal.$description: Neutral tracking for body and headings

wide.$description: Expanded tracking for uppercase badges and abbreviations

button.$description: Max recommended character cap for primary and secondary buttons (hard limit 28)

tab.$description: Max character cap for navigation tabs and segmented control items

badge.$description: Max character cap for status badges and pills

toast.$description: Max character cap for transient snackbar and toast notifications
